notes.title: Participating in Steam Scream Fest (Halloween 2024) !
notes.notes:
Steam Scream Fest (Halloween 2024) October 29th to November 5th “Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~”
will also participate!
We are having a 20% off sale. Don't miss it!

Shibuya is closed for Halloween this year, but strange things keep happening in this game.
Please check with your own eyes to see what kind of changes are occurring.

notes.title: [Campaign to survive this summer at “Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~”]
notes.notes:
<Notice>
[u][b][Let's survive this summer at the "Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~" campaign][/b][/u] Scheduled to be held in mid-August!

-A safety mode will be added for those who have given up on clearing the game due to the high difficulty level.
Use the remaining 10 and 5 checkpoints to clear the game you were about to give up on and reach the long-awaited ending!
　
・Summer only! This is a mode where you can play in Shibuya, which is constantly flooded with pools.
Survive the hot summer by playing in a cool, waterlogged world.
=> It was planned to be a summer-only feature, but due to popular demand, we made it a permanent feature!

--New PV--
https://youtu.be/QaOZGdm0QC4

*For those who have played the game
In addition to posting reviews, we are also looking for opinions such as requests for a campaign to be implemented, and requests for it to be permanent rather than limited to a limited time. You can submit reviews using the input field on the store page, so please give us your opinions.

notes.title: New features released as August campaign.
notes.notes:
-A safety mode has been added for those who have given up on clearing the game due to the high difficulty level.
Use the remaining 10 or 5 checkpoints to clear the game you were about to give up on and reach the long-awaited ending!
(Standard specifications are "selection error → go back 7 times" and "instant death trap → go back 5 times".)
　
・For the summer, we have added a mode where you can play in Shibuya, which is constantly flooded with pools.
Survive the hot summer by playing in a cool, waterlogged world.
(The initial setting is off.)

notes.title: Hint
notes.notes:
This is help for those who are stuck on the "Moonwalk".
That anomaly is now an intersection that you can cross by doing the [spoiler]"moonwalk" [/spoiler].
Do what the old man did and try [spoiler]crossing backwards[/spoiler].
